zh.ab.title: 关于这个看板
zh.ab.p1: 这是 ResearchWorld-Eval 的公开实验看板：ResearchWorld 和四个基线系统在 E2E 研究任务和公开基准上的实验进展与结果。看板是本项目产品的一部分，由 researchworld_eval dashboard 命令从仓库和运行记录生成，不手写会过时的内容。
zh.ab.p2: 两条规则：参考材料直接显示——任务的评测侧（原论文、评分细则、时间截止、参考答案、评分依据）在实验进行期间也公开，被测系统访问不到它，因为每次运行都屏蔽看板的地址；运行有什么产出就展示什么——论文、代码、数据、表格、图片都发布，唯一的检查是凭据：含凭据形状字符串的单个文件扣下并写明原因，发布前整站再逐字节扫描一次凭据，有一处命中就不发布。文件大小上限只是技术约束，超过的文件列出名字、大小和原因。
zh.ab.p3: 看板只读：只列事实，不下结论，也不提供停止、重启等操作。
zh.ab.sources_text: 运行记录（.project/runs/）、任务包和 MANIFEST（src/tasks/）、实验条件（src/experiments/）、被测系统的固定版本和出处（src/systems/）、术语表（dashboard/glossary.yaml）。
zh.ab.checks_note: 看板缺了什么、为什么：没有记录原因的缺失是“问题”，要修；来源本身说明不存在或无法知道的，列为“已说明”。

en.ab.title: About this dashboard
en.ab.p1: This is ResearchWorld-Eval's public experiment dashboard: progress and results of ResearchWorld and four baseline systems on E2E research tasks and public benchmarks. It is part of this project's product, generated by the researchworld_eval dashboard command from the repository and the run records, with nothing written by hand that could go stale.
en.ab.p2: Two rules: reference material is shown directly — a task's evaluator side (original paper, rubric, time cutoff, reference solution, score rationale) is public while experiments run, and a system under test cannot reach it because every run blocks the dashboard's addresses; whatever a run produced is shown — papers, code, data, tables and images are published, and the one check is for credentials: a file holding a credential-shaped string is withheld with the reason, and before publishing every byte of the site is scanned for credentials again; a single hit stops the publication. Size limits are only technical: a file over a limit is listed with its name, size and why.
en.ab.p3: The dashboard is read-only: it lists facts, draws no conclusions and offers no stop or restart.
en.ab.sources_text: Run records (.project/runs/), task packages and manifests (src/tasks/), experiment conditions (src/experiments/), the systems' pinned versions and provenance (src/systems/), the glossary (dashboard/glossary.yaml).
en.ab.checks_note: What the dashboard lacks and why: a gap without a recorded reason is a problem to fix; a gap the source explains (it does not exist, or cannot be known) is listed as explained.

en.it.blocklist_note: Besides the original paper, this item's blocklist also blocks these addresses, patterns and keywords; the dashboard's addresses are on every run's blocklist.
en.it.judges: LLM judge problems and handling (JUDGES.md entries)
en.it.no_judges: This benchmark is not scored by an LLM judge; JUDGES.md has no entry for it.
en.miss.audit.not-recorded: The run record has no audit result
en.miss.audit.setup-error: It failed during setup; there is no output to audit
en.miss.condition.unnamed: Its settings match no named condition
en.miss.condition.setup-error: It failed during setup; no run settings were made

en.run.unfinished_note: Its purpose is evaluation but it did not finish normally ({status}); it does not count as completed

en.res.process_note: Finished runs only (completed or failed); a run without a metric is left out of that metric's mean, and the brackets give how many runs have it. Turns follow each system's own count (a ResearchWorld role session, a Claude Code round trip); compare model requests across systems. Cost is the API's per-token charge; runs on a subscription login get an equivalent at list price, listed apart and never a charge.
en.rep.title: Summary report
en.rep.none: No runs in this batch yet.
en.rep.note: Each task × condition shows its latest evaluation run. Under the status is how the system or the command says it ended; the failing stage is analysed on the run page. Delivery: a benchmark item's paths named by the official prompt (an unchanged starting file counts as missing), an E2E task's paper PDF and code; when a system wrote its paper elsewhere and left a deliverable missing or unchanged, the harness copies it there as is and marks it, apart from what the system delivered itself. The process metrics are defined under Results.

en.rep.mapped: {p} copied as is by the harness from the system's own paper
en.rep.concluded: final per the maintainer, not rerun: {why}

Key outputs come first: the paper PDF, then the paper source, then the files the item asks for, else the entry file of the code.
